title: Pour-over coffee set
prompt: a pour-over coffee set on a board: grind beans, put a filter in the dripper, pour hot water from a gooseneck kettle, coffee drips into the carafe; see-through shows the grinder burrs and the water path through the grounds
blurb: Crank 15 g of beans through the burrs, tip the grounds into a paper filter, then bloom and pour 250 g of water from the gooseneck kettle and watch coffee drip into the carafe.
